evidence.title: Shadboard - Next.js 15 & Shadcn/UI Admin Dashboard Template

name: Shadboard
summary: Next.js 15 admin dashboard template with shadcn/ui: ready-made apps, pages, theme customizer and authentication.
description: An open-source admin dashboard template built with Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui. Ships ready-made apps and pages (email, chat, calendar, kanban, pricing, payment, settings), authentication flows, i18n, a theme customizer and reusable components, packaged as starter-kit and full-kit folders.
contains: apps and pages: email, chat, calendar, kanban, pricing, payment, settings
auth flows: sign in, register, forgot password, verify email
starter-kit and full-kit folders in the repo
built-in i18n, NextAuth authentication and access pages (401, 404, maintenance)
theme customizer for colors, border radii and light/dark mode
